column2: a sleek chin-length honey-blonde bob with soft side-swept bangs, completely covering her dark hair cap; the hair hugs the head (at most 10 pixels outside the cap on top), the ends curve in at the jaw; behind her neck the back of the bob is visible between the ends.

voluminous shoulder-length natural curly hair with defined ringlets, deep black-brown, middle part, completely covering her dark hair cap; the curls frame the face and rest on the shoulders; behind her head and neck the curly mass continues and is visible around the neck and above the shoulders.

two long thick braids in copper-auburn with a middle part, smooth on the head (hugging the skull, at most 6 pixels outside the cap), completely covering her dark hair cap; both braids hang in front of her shoulders down to the chest, tied with small elastics.

a sleek low bun at the nape in dark chocolate brown, the hair smooth and flat over the skull (at most 6 pixels outside her hair cap), completely covering the cap; the bun sits behind the head at the nape and peeks out on both sides of her neck; no loose strands.

a pink cotton crop top with short puffed sleeves and a sweetheart neckline with front lacing, the hem just under the bust, completely covering the bandeau; the inside back of the neckline is visible behind her neckline.
a cream cable-knit crew-neck sweater with long sleeves down to the wrists and a ribbed hem at the hips; the inside back of the neckline is visible behind her neck.
